notes: The biggest defect here was factual, not mechanical: five fields told the reader Taliyah has no hard CC. Unraveled Earth stuns anything that dashes through the minefield or is knocked into it, and both of Fizz's mobility spells are dashes — so the page was advising the exact input that gets you stunned. All five are corrected. Threaded Volley's derived flags claim grounding and hardCC but Riot's own description only gives a slow on Worked Ground, so I asserted neither (flag misfire, per the brief's rule). 'Use Weaver's Wall' in wants.foe[1] is a suspectNames false positive — the name is correct. Six report[] pronoun-only fixes exceed the two-per-matchup sweep cap but were all lint-flagged MISGENDER.
